description:
**Position Summary:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Business Analyst & Scrum Master to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams while driving Agile delivery. This role combines strong business analysis capabilities with Scrum facilitation to ensure high-quality, predictable, and business-aligned product delivery.

**Location:**

Mumbai - India

**What will your job entail?**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Business Analysis**

* Analyze business processes and functional requirements to identify improvement opportunities
* Gather, document, and validate business and system requirements with stakeholders
* Develop clear, implementation-ready user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria
* Review test cases and scenarios to ensure alignment with business requirements
* Support end-to-end delivery from requirement gathering to UAT and release

* Monitor key delivery metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, progress tracking)
* Promote collaboration across Business, Dev, QA, and Product teams
* Drive continuous improvement through retrospective outcomes and process enhancements
* Provide clear visibility on sprint progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders

**Key Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements
* Strong facilitation and conflict resolution skills
* Experience in handling production support and issue management
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field
* Proven experience in Business Analysis and Agile delivery roles
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
* Experience in insurance domain preferred but not mandatory
* Prior experience with Salesforce or similar platforms is a plus
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence is preferred

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Opportunity to work on evolving digital products in the insurance domain
* Exposure to cross-functional global teams and stakeholder interactions
* Ownership of both functional and delivery excellence
* Fast-paced, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment

title: Analyst/Associate – Middle Office Operations (Public Credit)
description:
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra Team: PFS Job Requisition #: R266881 Date posted: Oct. 26, 2026

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

  

Job Description

**Company Description**
-----------------------

**HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for clients. The firm manages strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit, including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high-yield bonds; asset-based finance; and real estate. The scale and breadth of the platform provide flexibility to invest in companies large and small through standard or customized solutions. Intellectual rigor and discipline are central to creating value for clients.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (HCM), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (JPMAM). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM. Following the transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity.

The HPS/BlackRock transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset-owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS formed a new Private Financing Solutions business unit (PFS), led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets. The combined platform includes more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally and offers capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. Scott Kapnick, Scot French and Michael Patterson joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick was appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.

**Team Description**
--------------------

The Middle Office team (MO) within Private Financing Solutions (PFS), BlackRock’s private credit platform, is responsible for ensuring that fund positions and cash balances are accurate and for managing the lifecycle of all trades and investments. Responsibilities include trade capture, trade settlement, loan administration, daily cash and position reconciliations, corporate-action elections and recordings, audit requests, new-mandate onboarding, and PnL break analysis and resolution with fund administrators. The team also handles ad hoc requests from deal teams and separately managed account clients and works closely with Deal Execution, Treasury, Fund Accounting, Fund Finance, Cash Management, Portfolio Analytics, Data Analytics, Valuations and Deal Teams.

**Position Description**
------------------------

HPS is seeking an Analyst to join the Public Credit Middle Office, a subgroup within the broader Middle Office team that focuses on the liquid credit business within PFS.

The individual should be highly organized, with strong attention to detail and effective written and verbal communication skills. The role requires the ability to meet strict deadlines, work independently and collaboratively, and demonstrate excellent critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. The platform is scaling rapidly, making comfort in a fast-paced environment essential.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Research and resolve cash breaks versus custodians.
* Research and resolve position breaks versus custodians, clients, administrators and other systems.
* Perform cash and asset reconciliations between internal systems, including Aladdin, and custodians.
* Play a key role in the daily reconciliation between HPS and BlackRock accounting systems.
* Provide daily oversight of loan and security administration in the firm’s accounting system, including delayed fundings, contracts, coupon payments, factor payments and maturities.
* Investigate transactional or accrual discrepancies.
* Provide full trade-lifecycle operational support for products including fixed- and floating-rate bonds, private placements, ABS, cross-currency swaps, term loans, delayed-draw term loans and revolvers.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of onboarding processes for new investments, including trade lifecycle, cash management, valuation, PnL recognition and reconciliation.
* Work closely with custodians, including responding to questions on how to apply cash.
* Assist with position confirmation and provide support to internal and SMA auditors.
* Interact daily with internal and external groups to troubleshoot booking and position discrepancies, including Front Office, Fund Accounting, Fund Administrators, SMA clients and auditors.
* Collaborate with technology teams on automation and workflow enhancements and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including scenario testing and error resolution before production release.
* Liaise with accounting, product control, valuations, investment data and other internal groups to resolve open queries and support team objectives.
* Participate in cross-functional initiatives and group-level projects.
* Manage transactional data for alternative products by sourcing information from legal documents and third-party notices and entering it into internal systems.
* Assist in trade execution.
* Ensure relevant controls are in place and diligently followed to maintain a risk-controlled environment.
* Provide oversight of daily and ad hoc processes and assist with issues, escalations and complex scenarios.
* Collaborate with external service providers and internal teams to exchange product and asset data and resolve operational issues.
* Maintain and regularly update process documentation and control frameworks.

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------

* Master's degree in Finance or Accounting or relevant field.
* 2+ years of experience in middle office/operations, data management, accounting or administration, with a focus on alternative investment funds.
* Deep understanding of alternative investment products, including hedge funds, structured products and private equity.
* Knowledge of trading and settlement.
* Understanding of lifecycle events, including coupons, factors, amendments, tenders and maturity.
* Experience with cash and position reconciliation.
* Strong Excel and Outlook management skills.
* Enjoys problem solving and critical thinking.
* Ability to resolve complex issues efficiently and independently by applying knowledge from training and past experience.
* Curiosity and a strong desire to learn and build knowledge continuously.
* Ability to use lookups, pivot tables and extensive formulas and to build them from scratch.
Ability to manage a high volume of email without missing important items, respond promptly and escalate when necessary.  

  

**Shift Timings -**

2- 11 PM

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
CommVersion runs managed live-chat and AI-assisted conversation products for websites across hundreds of client accounts. Every chat, greeting, lead and page view lands in our warehouse, and the data team turns that into the client dashboards, executive reporting and revenue models the business runs on.

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to own models in our dbt codebase end to end — from raw loaded tables through to the marts behind our Metabase and Power BI dashboards. This is a hands-on build role, not a reporting-request queue. You will write SQL and Python that runs in production every hour.

This suits someone roughly 1–3 years in who already writes real dbt models and solid SQL, and wants to go deeper on data modelling, orchestration and warehouse performance with a small, senior team around them.

Our Stack: You will work in all of this. We are not asking you to already know all of it — we are asking you to be strong in SQL, dbt and Python, and to pick up the rest fast.

What You’ll Do:

* **Build and own dbt models across our staging, intermediate, fact/dim and reporting layers — including incremental models with merge strategies, SCD-style history tables and change-log driven refresh logic.**
* Model the domain properly — clients, agents, products, chats, leads, traffic and revenue — with dimensional thinking, sane grain and keys that survive contact with real data.
* **Write dbt tests and data-quality checks (generic, singular and custom) so that a bad upstream load fails loudly instead of quietly reaching a client dashboard.**
* Build ingestion with dlt — new sources, incremental/persistent vs non-persistent load patterns, schema evolution, and migrating our remaining legacy connectors over.
* **Write Python where the tooling stops — pull from third-party APIs that dlt doesn't cover, handle pagination, rate limits and retries, land the data in Redshift, and call our existing AI services for enrichment.**
* Orchestrate in Airflow 3 — author and maintain DAGs, wire dependencies between load, transform and report stages, and keep run times and retries under control.
* **Build dashboards in Metabase and Power BI on top of your own models, and work directly with commercial and operations stakeholders on what they actually need.**
* Care about performance — distribution and sort keys, join strategy, incremental windows, and why the daily run got 40 minutes slower this week.
* **Work like an engineer — branches, PRs, code review, pre-commit checks and documented models. Nothing reaches production straight from a SQL client.**

**What We are Looking for:**

**Three tiers, and we mean them literally. The first is the bar. The second makes you a stronger candidate, but you will not be rejected for missing it. The third we teach you here — please don't screen yourself out over it.**

**Must have**

* 1+ year in an analytics engineering, data engineering or BI engineering role (internships and academic projects don't count towards this).
* **Strong SQL — window functions, CTEs, multi-table joins, aggregation at the right grain, and the ability to read someone else's 200-line query and explain what it does.**
* Working Python — requests/pandas, clean functions, error handling and logging. Enough to own a script that runs unattended every morning.
* **Data modelling fundamentals: facts vs dimensions, grain, and keys that hold up once the data gets messy.**
* A branch-and-pull-request workflow — your work reaches production through code review, not a SQL client.
* **Clear written and spoken English — you will talk directly to non-technical stakeholders.**

**Strongly preferred**

**These make you a stronger candidate. None of them is a rejection on its own.**

* Hands-on production dbt — ref/source, materializations, incremental models, tests, macros and Jinja.
* **Any orchestrator: Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Mage.**
* Any EL tooling: dlt, Fivetran, Airbyte, Meltano.
* **Dashboards built in any BI tool (Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Superset) with real stakeholders on the other side.**
* Redshift, or another columnar MPP warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks.
* **GA4 / BigQuery export, Google Ads or other marketing data sources.**
* Working with LLM or ML service outputs as a data source — scoring, classification, NER.

We'll teach you here

Nobody arrives knowing these. They are learned by owning a pipeline in production — which is exactly what this role gives you.

* **Slowly changing dimensions and history modelling — keeping last quarter's numbers correct when today's rates change.**
* Idempotency, backfills and late-arriving data — why a job that runs twice must not double your revenue.
* **Redshift performance: distribution and sort keys, VACUUM/ANALYZE, the SUPER type.**
* dlt, Airflow 3, dbt-checkpoint, sqlfluff and CI for dbt.
* **Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions and our CI/CD pipeline.**
* AWS: S3, IAM, ECS/EC2, Secrets Manager.
* **Our domain — what a chat, a greeting conversion, a lead and a client product actually mean. That takes everyone a few weeks.**

**Why This role**

* Small data team, real ownership — your models are the ones the business reports on, and you'll see them used the week you ship them.
* **A genuinely modern stack, kept current: dbt, Airflow 3, dlt, CI on every PR, and an active migration off legacy tooling that you'll help drive.**
* Exposure across the full path — ingestion, modelling, orchestration, AI-enriched data and BI — rather than one narrow slice of it.
* **Senior engineers who review your code properly and expect you to grow fast.**
* A proper deployment path — CI/CD with Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD and GitHub Actions. You'll work alongside it and pick it up here; we don't expect you to arrive knowing it.

To apply, send your CV along with a short note on one dbt model or data pipeline you built, what made it hard, and what you would do differently now. Links to GitHub, a dbt project or a dashboard you're proud of are welcome and count for more than a longer CV.

**Job Description:**
====================

**About the Role**
==================

Russell Investments is seeking a highly analytical, technology-minded Portfolio Implementation Analyst to join our Mumbai-based team supporting the fast-growing Personalized Managed Accounts (PMA) business. This role sits within a global portfolio management team responsible for implementing systematic, tax-aware and personalized investment strategies across client accounts.

You will support daily portfolio implementation, optimization, trade preparation and data validation while helping improve the systems and processes that make the business scalable. The strongest candidates will be comfortable working across multiple systems, investigating issues, using data to form a view, and translating problems and enhancement ideas into clear recommendations for portfolio managers, business partners and developers.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Support daily portfolio implementation, including account optimization, trade creation and review, compliance checks, cash management, data validation and exception resolution.
* Analyze optimizer results and portfolio data to identify unusual outcomes, data-quality issues, system defects and opportunities to improve decision rules or workflows.
* Work across investment, trading, risk, data and operational systems; determine whether breaks originate from data, configuration, process or technology and drive issues toward resolution.
* Use SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to query, reconcile and validate data, support root-cause analysis, and reduce manual checks where practical.
* Identify and help implement automation opportunities that improve accuracy, control, speed and scalability, including thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies.
* Translate business problems into clear requirements: articulate the issue, impact, evidence and recommended enhancement to peers, managers and developers; support testing and implementation.
* Coordinate with global portfolio management, trading, operations, research and technology teams on trades, cash activity, account events and implementation issues.
* Interpret and process security corporate actions and help resolve security master, pricing and other market-data exceptions across a large security universe.
* Document procedures, controls, recurring issues and findings; manage multiple priorities, execute directions accurately, and escalate material issues with concise analysis and recommended next steps.

**What We’re Looking For**
==========================

* 3-5 years of experience in investment management, portfolio operations, trading, investment technology, data analysis or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. A master’s degree, CFA progress/designation or other relevant qualification is beneficial but not required.
* Strong understanding of capital markets, investment portfolios, asset classes and/or performance measurement, combined with rigorous analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated comfort working with multiple systems and large data sets, including the ability to recognize when something does not look right, investigate why, and recommend a practical response.
* Working knowledge of SQL and strong Excel skills. Experience with Python, Power BI or other data/automation tools is a plus.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a problem, its business impact and a recommended solution to both investment professionals and technology teams.
* Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively; a self-starter who takes ownership, asks questions early and is candid when a concept, process or requirement is unclear.
* Strong organization, attention to detail and time management, with the ability to execute instructions consistently and accurately in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort making pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, documenting the rationale, and adjusting as new information becomes available.
* Curiosity, strong work ethic and a continuous-improvement mindset; willing to challenge the status quo constructively and look for better ways to work.

**Preferred Experience**
========================

* Retail or institutional trading, portfolio management, portfolio implementation or portfolio optimization.
* Axioma Portfolio or another portfolio optimization/risk platform; Bloomberg or similar market-data tools.
* Security-level corporate actions, security master/reference data, pricing data and exception resolution across a broad security universe.
* System testing, requirements gathering, process design, workflow automation or partnership with software developers and technology teams.
* Using AI or emerging technologies to streamline analysis, documentation, controls or investment workflows.
* Tax-managed investing, direct indexing or separately managed accounts is helpful, but prior U.S. tax-management experience is not required.

**How You’ll Work**
===================

This is a hands-on role in a rapidly growing business. You should be comfortable moving quickly, learning continuously and taking ownership from the outset. We value people who are direct, curious and dependable; who ask good questions rather than make silent assumptions; who can make a reasonable decision with incomplete information and explain their reasoning; and who actively look for opportunities to make the portfolio-management process more efficient, scalable and robust.

**Why Join PMA?**

* Join one of Russell Investments’ strategic growth businesses and help shape how a scaled, technology-enabled portfolio-management platform evolves.
* Gain exposure to global portfolio management, trading, optimization, risk, investment operations and technology while working with experienced investment professionals across regions.
* Build a career at the intersection of investing, data and technology, with meaningful opportunities to take ownership as the business and platform expand.
* Have visible impact: strong ideas, thoughtful analysis and effective automation can improve client outcomes and the way the team operates from day one.Portfolio Implementation Analyst

The role independently drives initiatives from discovery through implementation, translating business needs into clear, testable requirements while enabling an effective Agile delivery rhythm across business, product, engineering, data, and quality assurance teams.

**Key Responsibilities - Business & Systems Analysis**
======================================================

* Independently lead discovery and requirement workshops with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, product owners, developers, architects, data teams, and quality assurance teams.
* Understand business problems, objectives, processes, data needs, and user outcomes; translate them into well-structured functional and non-functional requirements.
* Create and maintain business requirement documents, functional specifications, process flows, data flows, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and requirements traceability.
* Break down complex requirements into clear, prioritized, sprint-ready user stories that are understandable to both business and technical teams.
* Perform impact, dependency, feasibility, gap, and data analysis for new capabilities, enhancements, defects, and change requests.

* Use SQL and other analysis techniques, where required, to validate data, investigate issues, support requirements, and confirm expected outcomes.
* Own functional quality for assigned initiatives, ensuring that delivered solutions remain aligned to approved business needs and acceptance criteria.
* Plan and support system testing, business validation, and user acceptance testing, including test scenarios, test data, defect triage, evidence, sign-off, and deployment of readiness.
* Maintain solution documentation and support-controlled transition into production, user communication, training, change management, and post-release validation.

**Key Responsibilities - Scrum & Agile Delivery**
=================================================

* Partner with the Product Owner and delivery team to maintain a healthy, prioritized, and sufficiently refined product backlog.
* Facilitate or support Scrum events as needed, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Prepare stories for refinement by confirming business value, scope, dependencies, assumptions, acceptance criteria, and readiness before commitment.
* Help the team establish a realistic sprint goal and maintain shared understanding of committed outcomes.
* Track story progress, decisions, blockers, dependencies, risks, and actions; proactively coordinate resolution and escalate matters that may affect delivery.

* Use delivery measures and team feedback to identify opportunities to improve requirement quality, flow, predictability, and ways of working.

* Where a dedicated Scrum Master is not assigned, provide day-to-day Scrum coordination for the project while continuing to own BSA responsibilities. This role supports team effectiveness and does not replace people management responsibilities.

* Take end-to-end functional ownership of small to medium initiatives, or a clearly defined workstream within a larger programme, with limited supervision.
* Build and maintain a delivery view covering scope, milestones, backlog readiness, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, stakeholder actions, and implementation readiness.
* Coordinate across globally distributed and matrixed teams, ensuring that the right stakeholders are engaged at the right stage.
* Identify ambiguity early, present options and recommendations, drive timely decisions, and document agreed outcomes.
* Balance business value, user needs, data availability, technical feasibility, quality, and delivery timelines when recommending an approach.
* Provide concise, fact-based status updates to project leadership and stakeholders, including progress, risks, decisions required, and proposed next steps.
* Contribute reusable templates, standards, frameworks, and lessons learned to strengthen Business Analysis and Agile delivery practices.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
========================================

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis, technology implementation, or a closely related role.

* Experience with common work management and documentation tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira and Confluence or equivalent platforms.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and managing multiple priorities in a complex, matrixed environment.

**Core Skills & Behaviors**
===========================

* Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, attention to detail, and ability to connect business requirements with system behavior.
* Ability to simplify complex concepts, ask effective questions, challenge constructively, and communicate recommendations clearly.
* Confident workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently, organize work, follow through on commitments, and maintain momentum across teams.

**About this role**

**Company Description**

HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.

HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”).Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).

The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally, offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. Date live: 09/07/2026


Business Area: Compliance


Area of Expertise: Data \& Analytics


Contract: Permanent

The VP — Data Analytics \& AI Lead is a senior leadership role within the Compliance division, responsible for defining and executing the data analytics and artificial intelligence strategy across all risk domains. The role holder will build and lead a high\-performing team that delivers Data analytics, machine learning models, and AI\-driven solutions to strengthen risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and reporting capabilities.
  

  

This individual will act as the bridge between Compliance subject\-matter experts and Technology teams, translating complex regulatory and business requirements into scalable, production\-grade analytical solutions. The role demands a unique combination of deep technical expertise, strong business acumen in financial services risk management, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across the organisation.


**Key Responsibilities**


Strategic Leadership \& Vision
  

* Define and own the multi\-year data analytics and AI roadmap for Compliance, aligned with the firm's enterprise data strategy and regulatory commitments.
* Identify and prioritise high\-impact use cases for Data Analytics ,AI/ML across credit risk, market risk, operational risk, financial crime, and compliance surveillance.
* Serve as the senior subject\-matter expert on Data Analytics , AI/ML applications in Compliance management, advising the Barclays Compliance functions on emerging capabilities, risks, and investment priorities.
* Champion a culture of data\-driven decision\-making across Compliance, driving adoption of advanced analytics among compliance professionals.

  

Advanced Analytics \& AI Delivery
  

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of machine learning models, NLP solutions, and generative AI applications for risk detection, early warning systems, regulatory reporting, and compliance monitoring.
* Deliver predictive analytics capabilities including, anomaly detection for financial crime, stress testing automation, and real\-time surveillance dashboards.
* Architect end\-to\-end ML pipelines from data ingestion and feature engineering through model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Drive the adoption of large language models (LLMs) and generative AI for regulatory document analysis, policy gap detection, and automated compliance assessments.

  

Model Risk \& AI Governance
  

* Establish and enforce robust AI governance frameworks including model risk management, explainability standards, bias detection and mitigation, and responsible AI practices.
* Partner with Model Risk Management (MRM) to ensure all analytics models meet internal validation standards and regulatory expectations (e.g., SS1/23, SR 11\-7, TRIM).
* Maintain comprehensive model inventories, documentation, and performance monitoring dashboards.
* Lead regulatory exam preparedness for AI/ML\-related enquiries from the PRA, FCA, and other supervisory bodies.

  

Data Strategy \& Infrastructure
  

* Collaborate with Chief Data Office, Data Engineering, and Cloud Platform teams to ensure Compliance has access to high\-quality, governed, and timely data.
* Define data quality requirements and risk data aggregation standards in alignment with BCBS 239 principles.
* Drive migration of legacy analytics to cloud\-native platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of enterprise BI dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and QlikSense.

  

Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication
  

* Build strong partnerships with senior stakeholders across Compliance, Technology, and Front Office to align analytics priorities with business needs.

  

  

Team Leadership \& Talent Development
  

* Recruit, develop, and retain a diverse, high\-performing team of data scientists, ML engineers, analytics engineers, and quantitative analysts.
* Establish clear career pathways, technical competency frameworks, and performance objectives for the analytics team.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and technical excellence, including participation in hackathons, research publications, and patent applications.
Technology \& AI Solution Architecture:


Lead the design, delivery, and evolution of the Compliance data analytics Platform, encompassing modern data architectures, advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI solutions. The role requires expertise in scalable data platforms, AI/ML model development and operationalization, MLOps, and AI governance, with a proven ability to deliver risk, regulatory, and financial crime solutions through intelligent applications. The successful candidate will ensure all AI capabilities are deployed within robust governance frameworks aligned to regulatory and model risk management standards.  

  



**Essential Qualifications \& Experience**


Education
  

* Master's degree in a quantitative discipline — Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications are advantageous (e.g., FRM, PRM, CFA, AWS/Azure ML certifications).

  

Experience
  

* Progressive experience in data analytics, data science, or AI/ML, with at least 5 years in financial services — preferably within Risk, Compliance, or regulatory functions.
* Leadership experience managing multi\-disciplinary analytics teams (6\+ individuals) in a regulated environment.
* Proven track record of delivering production\-grade ML models and AI solutions that have driven measurable business impact in risk management or compliance.
* Deep understanding of banking risk frameworks including credit risk (IRB models, IFRS 9, ECL), market risk (VaR, FRTB), operational risk (scenario analysis, loss data), and financial crime (AML, sanctions, fraud detection).
* Hands\-on experience with regulatory requirements such as BCBS 239, Basel III/IV, MiFID II, GDPR, and UK regulatory expectations (PRA SS1/23, FCA guidance on AI/ML).
* Demonstrated experience managing the full model lifecycle — from development through independent validation, regulatory approval, and ongoing monitoring.

  

Technical Skills
  

* Expert proficiency in Python, R, or Scala for statistical modelling and ML development.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Databricks).
* Hands\-on experience with ML frameworks — TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM.
* Experience with NLP and generative AI technologies — LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning.
* Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI) and MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow).
* Experience with BI and visualisation tools — Tableau, Power BI, QlikSense.
* Familiarity with data governance tools and metadata management platforms.
**Desirable Skills \& Experience**


* Experience implementing Responsible AI frameworks including fairness testing, explainability (SHAP, LIME), and bias mitigation at enterprise scale.
* Knowledge of graph analytics and network analysis for financial crime detection.
* Experience with real\-time streaming analytics (Kafka, Flink) for surveillance and monitoring use cases.
* Prior involvement in regulatory examinations, internal audit reviews, or supervisory engagement related to AI/ML models.
* Published research or patents in applied machine learning, risk analytics, or related fields.
* Experience leading cloud migration programmes for legacy risk analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with emerging regulations on AI (EU AI Act, UK AI regulatory framework) and their implications for financial services.
* ACAMS certification or AML/financial crime analytics expertise.
* Experience with Agile/SAFe delivery methodologies in large\-scale technology programmes.

  

You will be assessed on key critical skills for the role, such as Model Risk \& AI Governance, Analytical ability.
